name: slime
title: Slime
description: A glossy WebGPU slime that crawls, drips and splats. Hover and it reaches, click to splat it, drag to pull strands.

props.description: A figure with an accessible name that owns one WebGPU Canvas, mounted only while it is in view. Size it with className.

props.name: ink
props.description: Dark tone. Any three.js color string.

props.name: paper
props.description: Light tone.

props.name: glow
props.description: Green for the scatter and the veins.

props.name: night
props.description: Ink ground with a dark glassy body. Off gives a paper ground and a milky body.

props.name: viscosity
props.description: How thick the goo is: slower crawl, laggier lobes, heavier drips. 0.4 to 2.5.

props.name: reach
props.description: How far it reaches for the pointer and how far a strand stretches before it snaps. Also sets splat speed. 0.3 to 2.

props.name: veins
props.description: Strength of the veins. 0 hides them.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds the frame and stops rendering.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name.
props.default: "A glossy green slime that crawls around, drips, reaches for the pointer and splats when clicked"

props.name: className
props.description: Give the slime a size.
The raymarched plane and its physics without the Canvas. Needs a WebGPURenderer. Listens for pointer events on the canvas element.

props.description: Dark tone. Any three.js color string.

accessibility: A figure with an accessible name. The canvas is hidden from assistive tech.
Without WebGL it shows a static disc in the same tones.
Hover, click and drag are pointer gestures with no keyboard equivalent; the slime is decoration and holds no content.

animation.timing: Always while visible. The Canvas unmounts offscreen.
Crawls toward random targets past the edges, squashes on walls on underdamped springs, slower with viscosity
Trails the pointer with lag, snaps past the reach into a falling drop and recoils
animation.trigger: Hover or drag near the body

animation.timing: Drip, fly under gravity, stick to a wall, ooze down and crawl back to merge
Rises with tension, flashes on a splat or a snap and fades over about 0.5 s

docs: Requires React 19 and three r171 or later. Render <Slime className="aspect-video w-full" /> anywhere. Slime owns a Canvas with a WebGPURenderer, which falls back to WebGL2 on its own. SlimeScene uses TSL node materials, so mount it only in a Canvas whose renderer is a WebGPURenderer, such as GpuStage; a WebGL Canvas or drei View cannot draw it.
